title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2608.19737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on its temporal presentation, including duration and timing-slot allocation. Motivated by this finding, we use subtitles, which are common in real-world videos and allow semantic content to be presented under precise temporal control without appearing visually intrusive, as a natural attack medium. Based on this insight, we propose TempJail, a black-box video-based jailbreak framework that constructs query-aligned dialogue-style subtitle sequences a

translated_title: TempJail：通过字幕调度对大型视觉-语言模型的时序越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在视频理解和推理方面取得了显著进展。尽管已有大量关于文本和图像越狱攻击的研究，但针对LVLMs的视频越狱攻击仍未被充分探索。现有的视频越狱方法主要操纵嵌入视频中的文本内容，却忽视了这些信息在时间上是如何组织的。我们的分析表明，越狱攻击的有效性不仅取决于文本信息的语义，还取决于其时间呈现方式，包括持续时间和时隙分配。受此发现启发，我们利用字幕作为自然攻击媒介——字幕在真实世界视频中很常见，能够在精确的时间控制下呈现语义内容，且不会显得视觉上突兀。基于这一洞察，我们提出了TempJail，一个黑盒视频越狱框架，它构建了与查询对齐的对话式字幕序列。
tldr: 本文提出TempJail，一种利用字幕时序调度（如持续时间与时段分配）进行黑盒视频越狱攻击的新框架，揭示了时间呈现方式对LVLM安全性的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TempJail, a black-box video jailbreak framework leveraging subtitle temporal scheduling (e.g., duration and slot allocation), revealing the critical role of temporal presentation in LVLM security.
